news_mentions.headline: Next Woman Up: Gina Martinez Todd, Seahawks Managing Director of Partnership Development
news_mentions.description: In this installment of the Next Woman Up series, Gina Martinez Todd discusses a key component of leadership and how she's stayed at the top of her craft while working for the Seattle Seahawks over more than three decades.
news_mentions.body_text: women are rising up the ranks throughout professional football earning positions of power in a space that for too long was ruled almost exclusively by men we re seeing more and more women breaking barriers in the sport but what are the stories beyond the headlines who are the women shaping and influencing the nfl today answering those questions is the aim of the next woman up series while the conversational q as are edited and condensed for clarity this is a forum for impactful women to share experiences in their own words without further ado we introduce gina martinez todd seattle seahawks position managing director partnership development how did you get your start in a career in football i was a communications major majoring in journalism and public relations at the university of washington and i had no idea what i wanted to do with my life oddly enough i ended up in the nfl because i was trying to figure out all the things i didn t want to do i did not want to go work at a pr agency i did not want to go and write at a newspaper so as i was gaining experience i went to the one thing that i always loved which was football so i ended up working at a publication that covered the university of washington and washington state football teams and published the preseason glossy magazines for the nfl all 32 teams as i got closer to graduation i called the seahawks because the organization was right across the lake from my school to see what sort of internships or introductory positions they had they actually told me there was an internship program in the public relations department so i applied and ended up getting it i started at a really unique moment in time right before our late owner paul allen bought the team the former owners tried to move the team to southern california so my very exciting opportunity to work in the nfl almost didn t happen but mr allen went through a stadium referendum to build what is now lumen field and i was able to stay on as an intern for two years that was really a great start and set the groundwork to what s now going into my 32nd season i love how that worked out having been with the organization for 31 seasons how has your role expanded and what does your current position entail i loved working in public relations though it was very different at that moment in time than it is now but i needed more speed in my day to day activity so if there was downtime i would go help other departments scouting game presentation tickets with the new ownership our business operation exploded and our ticket office grew by four or five times i was approached about corporate sales making sure all of our advertisers and brands were well represented things like that and it was like this person was speaking a foreign language to me so i was splitting time between pr and the sponsorship group and i loved that energy i started off supporting the sales team managing activation that emerged into developing strategy and working with all of our business operations teams i loved being part of the team that sold our hearts out did a great job and made it happen we exceeded expectations and i was energized by that work we went through a transition where he team played in husky stadium for the 2000 and 2001 seasons and our late owner had a college sports marketing entity through that we were doing sponsorships with the university naming rights deals and working on washington state athletics as well we eventually moved to what is now lumen field so it was just this really cool crash course in sponsorship activation i loved that energy and got to wear a lot of hats and work in various roles within sponsorship account management activation and operations i loved it all along the way i had a lot of great teammates ask me why i wasn t in sales i would always say i m not a salesperson but what i didn t realize is my brain had been trained to understand how all the dots connect with football and how sponsorship can provide solutions at one point we were hiring for a director of sales position and our candidate didn t take the job when that person declined i immediately felt this shift in my body like it was time for me to really stretch and try something new i told my boss i wanted to throw my hat in the ring for the job he told me to come in the next day and we would figure out how to transition into that space so that s when i moved into business development which all about working in a different capacity with brands and people and integrating that work into our game day experience i continued to grow in that space but i never want to get complacent i ve always looked at my career as a marathon wanting to be thoughtful and present i was in a meeting with chief revenue officer amy sprangers and she said we were going to start a new business development team and that i was going to lead that team focusing on new business for the seahawks sponsorship portfolio i work with such great people within our partner ecosystem staff and the greater community you re now serving as managing director of partnership development what is the most challenging part about that role the most challenging part is trying to stay on top of trends what are emerging categories how are people elevating the fan experience we re really obsessed with how we are delivering the game day experience to our fans whether it s coming into lumen field or through the digital experience and how brands can help us you never have it figured out we have to constantly be thinking forward like that was great but where do we go now that s also the exciting part it s all about staying committed to learning that s a great point the seahawks are coming off a super bowl winning campaign so i can imagine the excitement around the team heading into this season i m curious when the team wins a championship has a losing season or just barely misses the playoffs how does that affect what you do there s always that little extra when you re coming off a super bowl because it s so special it s so hard to win you see the way the coaches and players prepare and we have no control over what happens on the field but i m a big believer in controlling what we can control and that s our business we have an amazing fan base and the 12s are so special to this organization it s about finding that connection with our partners and fans and where we can deliver business results consistently so whether you re winning or not we approach it the same way looking at your journey specifically why do you think you ve had so much success in your career i said yes to a lot especially early on i just wanted to learn and i had this insatiable appetite to learn which is where i found growth i m curious and i really believe in what our organizational priorities are and where we want to go in the community or from a business perspective i ve always believed i can be a really solid and consistent contributor to that vision when i was young and working in pr i knew that wasn t exactly what i wanted to do but i was curious enough to find where i wanted to grow that s when the light went on and it was all systems go i have always tried to know my tasks and how they help the greater good i think that s helped with the longevity i never thought in a million years when i first started that this was going to be a career i just went where my heart was which was football i love that now let s turn to mentorship do you have any mentors and what advice have you received from them i ve had so many over the years but i d probably say there are four or five who not only are mentors but are really part of that like consistent board of advisors where they are there for me at any point but the most influential person came early in my career scott patrick who started the sponsorship team and was vice president of that group he was very welcoming and made me feel like i could do anything even though i had no idea what i was really doing i knew i had the tools and skills to do my assignment but didn t know the business yet he was this amazing coach who inspired me to dream big and that has stayed with me scott unfortunately passed away in 2008 when i think about my mentors a lot of whom are in the seahawks organization which has a history of amazing teammates there are just some consistent themes they prioritize people relationships and want to do the right thing getting to know people and building relationships are important but when it s time to get the job done it s about rolling up our sleeves and meeting the goal anytime i ve had a moment with a leader they are always present when you re with them they are in the moment and that s important those leaders are humble driven and want others to win around them there are so many positives but they also know how to keep things real and have hard conversations it s how they meet people where they are i ve learned a lot about leadership styles it s a constant state of learning and what advice do you have for other women looking to get into a career in this space one of the things i hear a lot from women and i certainly have been there myself is overcoming your fears or feeling riddled with self doubt i m a big believer that we all have those voices on our shoulders that are in your ear one is fire and one is fear you have to figure out which voice you re going to lean into listen to the fire trust your gut and lean into the job or situation i also want to encourage just being the best at whatever it is you do don t be the best woman for the job be the best person for the job you ll have setbacks everyone does but stay accountable to yourself your team and keep moving forward that s great advice i really like that having been in the league for over three decades how have you seen the industry change for women when i started there weren t a lot of women in leadership roles so it s been cool to see the emergence of women not only in the league but running departments and at the executive level i m really proud to be in an organization that recognizes that i remember as an intern even working training camp there wasn t even women s gear it was just the smallest size of the men s stuff that fit you like a tent having women on the football side as well these are all things to be celebrated and lastly what are you most proud of from a business perspective i m really proud of doing partnership deals that have win win outcomes i have made so many relationships along the way and i really do want our brands to win i am a brand loyal person through and through i m always drinking the right beverage and flying my partner airline our team worked extensively on the extension of our naming rights deal and that was a really proud moment we were so well prepared that the process moved quickly once we started the pitch it s really rewarding to be part of and achieve those wins i m also proud that my husband and i are raising two young men and being present for them and their experiences is so important i m proud that i get to wear both hats do this job and prioritize my family

news_mentions.headline: Rams leaning into villain role ahead of 2026 season: 'These other teams probably hate us'
news_mentions.description: There's good reason for others to dislike the Rams in 2026. They feature the reigning NFL MVP, completed a blockbuster trade for Myles Garrett, and topped their sundae by welcoming back Aaron Donald.
news_mentions.body_text: prior to first pitch at dodger stadium actor jason bateman narrates a pregame hype video that ends with him loosely quoting the movie scarface you need teams like us so you can point your finger and say that s the bad guy the dodgers los angeles gridiron counterparts are leaning into the same role entering the 2026 nfl season you know all these other teams probably hate us rams safety quentin lake said via the los angeles times they think we re like the new dodgers or something like that there s good reason for others to dislike the rams in 2026 they feature the reigning nfl mvp in quarterback matthew stafford completed a blockbuster trade for defensive player of the year myles garrett and topped their sundae by welcoming back all pro defensive tackle aaron donald from retirement at the end of august it s not quite a dream team but it s certainly a squad that loaded up on talent like the dodgers and one that is focused solely on the ultimate prize a lombardi trophy with a clear intent to target football s mountaintop anything less will be considered a failure it s special to be part of a team that can truly go all in and bring in some new firepower to help us be able to reach the goals that we have in store for ourselves defensive lineman kobie turner said the rams are far from the first team to make aggressive moves in an offseason and arrive to great fanfare at the start of a new season the 2011 eagles took a similar approach leading quarterback vince young to refer to them as a dream team a moniker that aged poorly after they finished 8 8 the 2019 browns added odell beckham traded for edge rusher olivier vernon and graced the covers of leading magazines as a favorite team to watch in a season that ultimately ended in a disappointing 6 10 finish the rams are different from those squads however because they ve already gotten close to the super bowl los angeles 2025 team was considered to be one of the two best in the nfl and reached the nfc championship game where the rams fell to the eventual super bowl lx champion seahawks since that loss general manager les snead has addressed their greatest weaknesses rebuilding the secondary by trading for cornerback trent mcduffie and adding his former chiefs teammate jaylen watson then snead followed that up with the trade for garrett which lured donald out of retirement the rams are fully stocked for a super bowl run now they have to go prove they re worth the hype starting thursday night against the 49ers in australia it gets down to how do we come together as a team coach sean mcvay said but it s hard to say top to bottom that the collection of individuals is not very special

news_mentions.headline: Rams coach Sean McVay sees late travel to Australia for opener as best course of action
news_mentions.description: Sean McVay has never been afraid to buck conventional NFL logic, and he is doing so once again with the Rams’ unusual travel plans for their season opener in Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: los angeles sean mcvay has never been afraid to buck conventional nfl logic and he is doing so once again with the los angeles rams unusual travel plans for their season opener in australia the rams are leaving southern california on tuesday night and will arrive in australia on thursday roughly 24 hours before their game against the san francisco 49ers kicks off at 10 35 a m local time on friday morning at the melbourne cricket ground the niners will spend one week in melbourne having arrived last friday for what is expected to be the first of several nfl regular season games in a country and venue traditionally associated with cricket and australian rules football it doesn t mean that we think we re right and a different approach is wrong mcvay said sunday it s just what we think is best based on the things that we ve done and what we ve learned over our time here mcvay said the plan was influenced in part by how the rams approached their game against the jacksonville jaguars in london last october when they arrived on saturday morning for a sunday afternoon start they rolled to a comfortable 35 7 win at wembley stadium however they had already spent a week on the east coast after playing at the baltimore ravens reducing both the flight s length and impact of adjusting to a new time zone this time the rams will be spending approximately 15 hours in the air albeit with lie flat seats available to all players and coaches i feel like we re just keeping it as normal as we possibly can quarterback matthew stafford said sunday is like a wednesday for us in our world wednesday thursday friday hop on the plane and go we obviously have experience with doing it in a different direction all that kind of stuff i understand last year in london but it felt like it worked out for us how the two nfc west foes fare in the game and in the following weeks after their contrasting routes could have teams around the league looking to copy the more successful model in years to come there are nine international games scheduled this season and nfl owners approved plans in may to play the maximum of 10 games allowed under the current collective bargaining agreement beginning in 2027 nfl commissioner roger goodell has expressed interest in having every team play one international game each season for a total of 16 the league already has a multiyear contract with visit victoria the official state tourism company to host games in melbourne with the nfl granting the rams global marketing rights in japan south korea and china along with being one of four teams to have marketing rights to australia and new zealand this could be the first of many long road trips to australasia or the pacific rim for mcvay and his club we ve tested it out with some guys and we feel like it s been positive but that s what went into the approach mcvay said copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Kyle Shanahan, 49ers 'fired up' to play in Australia despite losing L.A. 'home game' vs. Rams
news_mentions.description: The 49ers have arrived in Australia, mostly gotten over the impact of the long flight and now are getting prepared to open their season Friday in Melbourne against the Rams.
news_mentions.body_text: melbourne australia the san francisco 49ers have arrived in australia mostly gotten over the impact of the long flight and now are getting prepared to open their season friday in melbourne against the los angeles rams the niners left california last wednesday arrived in australia on friday and were set for their first practice of game week on monday at aami park in melbourne feeling mostly refreshed after players got a day to explore the city the rams are still back home and won t arrive until thursday it took a couple days to adjust but feeling real good today coach kyle shanahan said most of the city i ve seen out of my window i ve gotten to go on one walk it s a little different for coaches we re in the season so we re not out much but players had yesterday off so i know they got out a little bit and they ve spoken very highly of everything some players went to an australian football league game at the melbourne cricket ground where the 49ers will face the rams in the first nfl regular season game ever played in the country star running back christian mccaffrey didn t make it to the game but heard positive reports from his teammates he has enjoyed his time here so far and is glad the team got to make this long trip he said the instructions from the team s training staff made sure that the jet lag wasn t a big factor with the main issue just being cooped up on a plane for so long but now he s refreshed and ready to play we re fired up man he said this has been such a cool experience obviously there s a lot of question marks when you hear you re playing in australia but since we ve been here man it s been so cool the people are unbelievable the food s incredible the coffee s great the atmosphere you can already feel it it s just been a lot fun so we re super fired up we re here shanahan wasn t so excited when it was first announced that san francisco was opening the season here instead of playing the rams in a much shorter trip to los angeles in front of what is usually a partisan 49ers crowd but his view has changed a bit after making the trip and hearing how many 49ers supporters are expected at the game when i said that that was nothing against australia or anything that s just about competition and how important our 17 games are he said it s cool for us just we always have an advantage of having one i see it as one home game a year in l a just the way our fans are and take over that stadium so it was disappointing to let them off the hook and get them out of that but i have a feeling knowing how our fans roll i have a feeling they won t be much different here i expect to have a good showing i wouldn t say it hit me right on the plane but after being here for a couple days this is the right time to be here it s the right place to be and it s the right team to go against san francisco held its first full practice of the week monday in australia which was still sunday night back in california shanahan typically gives an injury update on the first practice day of a game week but opted against it because the rams don t have to do it until they practice on monday in california which will be tuesday in australia so any updates on the status of players like tight end george kittle and defensive end nick bosa will have to wait because we re technically in the future from where we re from and the rams are in the present i don t have to talk about injuries until tomorrow shanahan said so i m not talking about them the one notable injury update shanahan did give was that defensive end sam okuayinonu broke his foot at the team s last practice before leaving on wednesday he was placed on injured reserve and will miss most of the season the niners kept the same eight captains for the season that they had last year quarterback brock purdy will be joined by mccaffrey kittle bosa kyle juszczyk trent williams fred warner and deommodore lenoir copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Steelers' Alex Highsmith: There's 'added motivation' to send Aaron Rodgers out 'the right way'
news_mentions.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers are plenty motivated to break through and challenge for a Super Bowl, but doing so would included the added benefit of sending Aaron Rodgers out in proper fashion.
news_mentions.body_text: the pittsburgh steelers are already plenty motivated heading into the regular season they haven t won a playoff game since the 2017 campaign having dropped five wild card matchups in a row and are hungry to break through under mike mccarthy their first new head coach since 2007 while they don t necessarily need more fuel added to the fire there s also this aaron rodgers has declared that the 2026 campaign will be his last in the nfl we know our goal linebacker alex highsmith said via the pittsburgh tribune review s chris harlan not just get to the playoffs but when we get there to make noise to win and go to the super bowl but there definitely is extra added motivation to send eight out the right way rodgers a four time most valuable player and 10 time pro bowler who is the active leader in a smorgasbord of passing categories with 66 274 career yards 527 touchdowns a 1 4 interception percentage and a 102 2 passer rating hasn t gone to the super bowl since the 2010 campaign a game he won against the steelers donning black and gold for the first time last season rodgers led pittsburgh to the playoffs but went out in a way that would have been anything but fitting for one of the most talented passers in nfl history he threw for just 146 yards with a 51 5 completion percentage in a loss to the houston texans and tossed a pick six in what could have been his last pass attempt as a professional rodgers instead returned to the steelers reunited with his old head coach mike mccarthy and buoyed by an influx of talent to work with pittsburgh traded for michael pittman and added two more pass catchers through the draft germie bernard and kaden wetjen in an effort to improve upon a defense that allowed the seventh most yards in 2025 the steelers also brought in defensive backs rayshawn jenkins jaquan brisker and jamel dean dean should feel right at home trying to win a ring with the added benefit of potentially sending an all time great out on top he was in his second year with the tampa bay buccaneers when tom brady came to town and helped elevate them to super bowl champions it s definitely a similar feeling dean said aaron s always been one of the top quarterbacks that i praise there s a lot of confidence in him knowing that he s still got it tampa bay s super bowl lv victory didn t wind up being the end for brady he played for two more years falling short each time by every indication this season will be rodgers last ride however it ends dean who said he believes pittsburgh has all the right pieces is envisioning the same conclusion as highsmith and others it would be nice to send him out on a good note knowing that he had a legendary career the cornerback said

news_mentions.headline: Bears' Jonah Jackson: D'Andre Swift 'seems to be finding another gear' in Year 2 under Ben Johnson
news_mentions.description: Chicago Bears running back D'Andre Swift feels himself playing faster heading into Year 2 of Ben Johnson's offense, the first time he's played in the same scheme in back-to-back years during his NFL career.
news_mentions.body_text: the conversation around spending multiple years in the same offensive system usually highlights quarterbacks especially young ones like the bears caleb williams of course the benefits extend across the entire unit and the consistency from playing in ben johnson s scheme for consecutive years particularly seems to have provided a boost for running back d 39 andre swift going into the second year in this system i have a better understanding of the offense in general and where i need to be swift told jason lieser of the chicago sun times i feel really good about it it s the first time i ve been in a system for consecutive years in a while so i paid attention to the self scout from last year and figured out what i need to do a better job of i m honing in on the little details so that allows me to play faster it hasn t only been a while since swift played in the same coach s system in back to back years the upcoming season his seventh in the league will mark the first time swift has ever done it as a pro the first nfl offense he learned was darrell bevell s with the lions in 2020 bevell was notably named detroit s interim head coach after the team fired matt patricia during the season swift then played under offensive coordinator anthony lynn in 2021 and ben johnson in 2022 before being traded to the eagles and playing in brian johnson s offense in 2023 swift s first season in chicago was his most hectic of all as the bears fired shane waldron in early november and bumped thomas brown up to interim oc roughly two weeks later brown became the team s interim head coach following matt eberflus firing swift reunited with ben johnson in 2025 and produced the second 1 000 yard rushing season of his career at long last he can now build off the familiarity he has in johnson s offense instead of playing catch up throughout preseason and it isn t just swift who has felt the difference in his rushing one of his blockers guard jonah jackson has seen it too he s always been a pretty polished runner jackson said but he seems to be finding another gear swift has long been a quick dangerous runner but if he indeed takes it up a notch by being able to play and react more naturally it would be a boon to a bears offense that already benefits from williams heroics under center and one of the better play callers in the league there s no reason we shouldn t get off to a fast start swift said of chicago s rushing attack with a week left before putting it to the test

news_mentions.headline: Commissioner Roger Goodell agrees on extension through 2030 season; fifth re-up of career
news_mentions.description: The league has informed teams that Commissioner Roger Goodell agreed to terms with NFL owners on a contract extension through the 2030 season, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: commissioner roger goodell has agreed to terms with nfl owners on a contract extension through the 2030 season the league announced sunday espn s adam schefter initially reported the extension goodell s current contract was set to run through march of 2027 after signing an extension in october 2023 it is now set to expire on march 31 2031 his newest extension comes with negotiations for a new collective bargaining agreement with the current one also expiring in march 2031 and broadcasting deals forthcoming along with a potential move to an 18 game season a memo sent from compensation committee chairman robert kraft to the other team owners obtained by espn and nfl network expanded on the agreement describing it as heavily performance based with more than 95 of the total compensation tied to roger s and the nfl s performance measured against various metrics and at the discretion of the compensation committee we believe we are very fortunate to have roger at the helm for the next four years the memo continued goodell 67 succeeded hall of famer paul tagliabue when he was elected nfl commissioner in 2006 he is the eighth full time commissioner in league chronicle and after tagliabue s passing in november 2025 is the only living nfl commissioner this is goodell s fifth extension as he previously re signed in 2009 2012 2017 and 2023 ahead of his previous re up goodell declined to address speculation that 2027 would be his final year clearly that wasn t the case goodell s time with the nfl began in 1982 as an administrative intern in the league office serving then commissioner pete rozelle since taking over as commissioner goodell s tenure has been marked by improved safety in the game piloting the league through the covid 19 pandemic without a single game canceled the game s massive growth globally and the support of growing flag football which will debut in the 2028 summer olympics

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Harrison Smith returns for 15th season with Vikings on one-year, $12.25M deal
news_mentions.description: Six-time Pro Bowler Harrison Smith signed back with Minnesota, the team announced Saturday. The one-year contract is worth $12.25 million.
news_mentions.body_text: over the course of 14 seasons harrison smith has been a mainstay in the minnesota vikings defensive backfield after an offseason and preseason of indecision the safety has chosen to play at least one more year the six time pro bowler signed back with minnesota the team announced saturday the one year contract is worth 12 25 million with a max value of 16 25 million with playoff incentives nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo reported per sources smith s future in minnesota and the nfl had been in flux since he was designated as a post june 1 release on march 11 the cut amounted to a procedural move as the team still left the door open for his return now smith has returned with just eight days until minnesota s season opener against green bay the safety joins kyle van noy as a late arriving veteran defender to brian flores defense van noy signed with the vikings practice squad earlier this week smith has been a versatile standout for the vikings going to five consecutive pro bowls from 2015 19 he s played 207 career games all for minnesota with 203 starts 1 180 tackles 39 interceptions four returned for touchdowns 106 passes defensed 13 forced fumbles 10 fumble recoveries and 21 5 sacks he is tops on the vikings all time list in pick sixes and passes defensed fourth in interceptions and fifth in games played in 2026 the 37 year old hitman will anchor a defensive backfield led by fellow safety josh metellus and starting cornerbacks byron murphy and isaiah rodgers smith and minnesota will host the rival packers on sunday sept 13 at 4 25 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez on if he anticipates playing Week 1 without new deal: 'I'm focused on today'
news_mentions.description: Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez told reporters he is "focused on today" when asked whether or not he'd play in New England's Week 1 opener without an extension.
news_mentions.body_text: the patriots and seahawks open up the season with a super bowl rematch on wednesday new england s star cornerback christian gonzalez now back from a camp injury has been practicing with the team in preparation however he s still seeking an extension and he didn t give the most transparent answer on saturday regarding his week 1 availability i m focused on today gonzalez said during his news conference when asked if he anticipates playing against seattle should he still not have a new deal right now this practice in what 30 minutes 40 minutes worried on that right now so we ll focus on that gonzalez indeed practiced saturday just like he has for all of training camp outside the time he missed due to injury he s expressed frustration over the lack of an extension in recent weeks though so there is some tension mounting as the sides have struggled to come to an agreement asked if there was momentum to get a deal done gonzalez said i don t know reporters also questioned if he would consider demanding a trade if he begins the season without an extension i m here right now gonzalez said i m here like i said i m worried about this practice focused on this practice i ll always be where my feet are and do what i ve got to do gonzalez reached his first pro bowl last season contributing 69 tackles and 10 passes defensed for a new england defense that ranked fourth in points allowed he turned it up a notch in the playoffs recording an interception a sack and a league leading seven passes defensed the pats picked up his fifth year option following the breakout campaign though gonzalez made his desire for an extension clear by skipping voluntary organized team activities shortly after gonzalez and the rest of the patriots reported to training camp team owner robert kraft publicly stated new england had offered the cornerback the largest contract in franchise history regardless no such agreement has come to fruition gonzalez s cornerbacking counterpart devon witherspoon notably became the highest paid cb in the league after receiving an extension from seattle on aug 15 setting a 33 million per year bar that gonzalez is presumably aiming to match or exceed with four days left until the season opener it remans to be seen if the pats and gonzalez can work out an extension and if there are any repercussions should they fail to do so

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Greg Newsome on facing George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb in Week 1: 'Great players, but I like our chances'
news_mentions.description: Giants cornerback Greg Newsome recognizes how dangerous Cowboys wide receivers CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens are, but he still likes New York's chances to slow them down.
news_mentions.body_text: the extended window before the start of the 2026 nfl season provides opportunity for a little extra bulletin board material new york giants cornerback greg newsome as complimentary as he was while doing so might have provided some for the dallas cowboys ahead of their prime time week 1 matchup asked wednesday about squaring off against dallas wide receivers george pickens and ceedee lamb newsome showered them with praise despite maintaining complete confidence in big blue s defensive abilities he s great at the catch point newsome said of pickens via pat leonard of the new york daily news that s something he s been great at since he got in the league is just being able to make the tough catches you ve got number 88 ceedee he can line up anywhere do a lot of great things newsome added definitely great players but i like our chances newsome of course is no stranger to pickens though the pass catcher previously described the corner as one in 2024 when newsome was with the cleveland browns and pickens played for the pittsburgh steelers the two were involved in a scuffle on the final play of a week 12 upset by cleveland when asked about newsome a few weeks later pickens told reporters i don t even know who that is newsome who had in fact played in the same division as pickens for three seasons at that point fired back that pickens was a guy who cares about himself rather than his team two years later newsome and pickens find themselves as divisional opponents once again the cowboys boast one of the league s most explosive offenses in large part thanks to the duo of pickens and lamb while the giants defense is hoping to rediscover respectability under new coach john harbaugh and defensive coordinator dennard wilson after finishing 26th in points allowed last season newsome a newcomer to new york has full faith in the giants doing just that shutting down the cowboys passing attack in the sunday night football opener would go a long way in proving it

news_mentions.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels aims to remind people of his talent: 'I can't live off’ 2024 season
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels' follow-up to his 2024 Offensive Rookie of the Year campaign proved arduous and underwhelming. The Washington Commanders quarterback is intent to reset the narrative once again in Year 3.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels follow up to his 2024 offensive rookie of the year campaign proved arduous and underwhelming the washington commanders signal caller is intent to reset the narrative in year 3 perhaps again rising to the forefront of a stellar quarterback draft class a lot of people what they last saw was me getting hurt so what can i say i can t live off of what was done in 24 daniels said in an interview with sports illustrated s albert breer obviously salute to the other guys in my class drake maye did what he did so did caleb williams so did bo nix hopefully down the line we can go down as the greatest qb class i know we have a long way to go but shout out to them honestly so i have a chance when i get out there in week 1 to showcase my talents once again and remind a lot of people daniels played just seven games due to a sprained knee early in the 2025 season and later a dislocated left elbow but it wasn t solely the absences that turned it into a down year daniels also produced worse results he lost five of his starts the same number of defeats the commanders experienced throughout the entirety of his 17 game rookie season and his completion percentage dropped from 69 0 to 60 6 for a number of reasons daniels could easily bounce back to the form he displayed when first breaking onto the nfl scene wide receiver terry mclaurin is back healthy now joined by stefon diggs who is coming off his seventh 1 000 yard receiving season washington drafted an enticing pass catcher in antonio williams in the third round and while daniels no longer has trusty target zach ertz at tight end chigoziem okonkwo offers a little more pop at the position there s also new offensive coordinator david blough s system which daniels and co believe is perfectly suited for the qb s play style the balance of play action passes the bootlegging stuff that we re able to run to marry up with our run game get those guys moving laterally it s going to help out to be able to get some shots in to showcase what i can do with my arm daniels said i m a passer before i m a runner god just blessed me with legs and the ability to do both he blessed me with legs a lot of people in this league don t have there are some guys that can do it but i look back to the year when josh allen won mvp but lamar jackson had that year and he was still lamar but i think he threw for like 4 000 yards lastly daniels intends to lean on the lessons learned from the injuries he endured in 2025 though he won t change who he is a world class scrambler who rushed for 891 yards as a rookie and 39 7 yards per game in his second season daniels will pick his spots and be smarter about avoiding danger it s situational he said early in the season games are lost more than they re won guys are getting in football shape and feeling things out but when it gets to november december when everybody should be playing their peak football you build up all those reps through time and those games come down to the one yard or one possession so every possession every play matters there aren t many predicting an nfc east title for the commanders and detractors of daniels or the team will rightfully point to an offensive line that struggled throughout camp in the wake of left tackle laremy tunsil tearing his triceps the club didn t have a ton of people in its corner before going all the way to the nfc championship game with daniels as a rookie though rather than resting on having proven doubters wrong once before daniels now sets out to do it again starting with the team s season opener against the philadelphia eagles

news_mentions.headline: Former Bills head coach Sean McDermott predicts Buffalo will reach Super Bowl LXI
news_mentions.description: Former Bills head coach Sean McDermott still roots for Buffalo and believes the team can reach the Super Bowl under Joe Brady.
news_mentions.body_text: nfl media analysts made their super bowl lxi predictions on thursday sean mcdermott recently took his shot at forecasting a matchup as well the former buffalo bills head coach who visited the los angeles rams during training camp amid his year off from coaching was asked on the rich eisen show what could prevent l a from winning it all following a transformative offseason while he likes the rams to make it to the big game mcdermott noted there s other teams he also believes in namely his former one it would be bills rams mcdermott said when asked about his super bowl prediction that would be a great super bowl bills rams listen people ask me all the time hey do you still root for your old team and i said why wouldn t i of course i do i mean the impact that you want to have as a head coach on a team and a community that s one thing but man oh man the impact that that team that building and that community had on me and my family we ll remember that for the rest of our lives that s part of sports the wins and the losses are important but the impact you leave or that is left on people and the fan base and them on you that s the real part of sports the bills fired mcdermott in january following their divisional round exit ending a partnership that had produced eight playoff trips and a 98 50 record over nine years but never a super bowl berth buffalo replaced mcdermott by promoting offensive coordinator joe brady to head coach a move the club believed combined consistency with a new voice at the top that could finally help the bills break through though none of their moves were as earth shattering as the rams trading for myles garrett or having aaron donald unretire the bills went on to retool in a way that impressed mcdermott they traded for dj moore giving quarterback josh allen a certified wr1 and added pass rusher bradley chubb and defensive back chauncey gardner johnson to a defense that s ranked in the top 12 in points allowed for five years running with what they ve done the moves that general manager brandon beane has made and the activity they ve had on the roster just over the last x amount of months i think has been very important mcdermott said so i think if you re betting on a super bowl contender they re certainly one of them i don t see why you wouldn t bet on them it s a humble move for mcdermott to continue backing a team that moved on from him after nearly a decade of sustained success and his humility carried over to his assessment of buffalo s new man in charge most coaches come into a job where the organization is sick or unhealthy in some way mcdermott said joe s coming into a job in a unique fashion i think they are well positioned i know joe is going to do a phenomenal job he spent four years in our building and that s an advantage in and of itself i have all confidence in joe brady moving forward for the buffalo bills four nfl media analysts predicted a bills rams super bowl to cap off the 2026 season with two expecting confetti to fall for los angeles and two calling a buffalo victory mcdermott did not provide a winner to break the tie but it s not hard to guess who he d be pulling for

news_mentions.headline: Packers RB Josh Jacobs’ initial court appearance moved up to Sept. 10
news_mentions.description: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs’ initial court appearance on two misdemeanor charges stemming from a May altercation with his girlfriend has been moved up two months and now will take place next week.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay packers running back josh jacobs initial court appearance on two misdemeanor charges stemming from a may altercation with his girlfriend has been moved up two months and now will take place next week jacobs hearing originally was scheduled for nov 17 the hearing now is set for thursday three days before the packers open the season at minnesota the nfl has placed jacobs on the commissioner s exempt list which prevents the three time pro bowl running back from playing or practicing but allows him to keep receiving a paycheck the nfl made that move sunday three days after brown county wisconsin district attorney david lasee announced that jacobs was being charged with battery and criminal damage to property upon request and with the club s permission players on the commissioner s exempt list may be allowed at the facility for meetings individual workouts therapy and rehabilitation and other non football activities the nfl is investigating jacobs situation and he could be suspended by the league any games he misses while on the exempt list would count toward his suspension but he would have to repay the money he earned during that time jacobs lawyers david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac have noted that the move to the commissioner s exempt list is not a final determination they added that jacobs looks forward to his return to the team and the nfl jacobs was arrested may 26 three days after hobart lawrence police officers came to his home to investigate a disturbance police said jacobs girlfriend told them she had a lump on her head as a result of jacobs actions according to police the woman said she had been looking through jacobs phone and saw he was talking to other women and that she threw the phone in anger without breaking it she told police that jacobs had her phone and she told him he could look through it police said the woman indicated she tried to retrieve her phone from jacobs but he grabbed her arm and began a struggle that lasted several minutes they left the home in separate vehicles before eventually returning according to police the woman was trying to exit a garage door when jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took the phone from her while she was on the ground the criminal complaint says surveillance footage from the camera system in the garage backed up the woman s statement packers general manager brian gutekunst said this week that the team hadn t seen that video footage he expressed hope that jacobs would be available to play at some point this season but we re going to let this process play out and we ll be prepared either way gutekunst said jacobs is coming off a 2025 season in which he rushed for 929 yards and 13 touchdowns the packers don t have any other running backs who ran for more than 106 yards last year green bay acquired 2025 third round pick kaleb johnson from the pittsburgh steelers on sunday to join a running back room that also includes 2024 third round pick marshawn lloyd and chris brooks green bay has pierre strong on its practice squad copyright associated press 2026
