news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season: Predicting stat leaders in 11 major categories
news_mentions.description: Is Joe Burrow poised to bounce back with a prolific passing season? Can Myles Garrett accomplish the rare feat of pacing the league in sacks in consecutive seasons? Bobby Kownack predicts the NFL's 2026 leaders in 11 major statistic categories.
news_mentions.body_text: with the regular season almost upon us and more fantasy drafts taking place every day it s a valuable exercise to go through some of the major statistical categories and forecast how players could fare in 2026 which quarterback will march his team down the field with ease week to week who s likely to churn out the most rushing yards find the end zone with the greatest regularity or work their sack artistry at a level above all others there s naturally a degree of unpredictability to such predictions for as great as he s always been not many saw matthew stafford leading the nfl in passing yards and passing touchdowns for the first time in his career at 37 years old but there are tea leaves of sorts to read in the form of team situations opportunity changes and past metrics below are my predictions for the top five finishers in 11 key statistical categories with the names included very likely to vie for real life awards and light up fantasy scoreboards passing yards rest of top five 2 jared goff 3 dak prescott 4 justin herbert 5 baker mayfield one of the surest paths to quarterbacks racking up passing yards is commanding a top end offense that must frequently compensate for a subpar defense last year burrow s bengals and prescott s cowboys threw the ball the second and third most respectively while fielding defenses in the bottom three in points allowed both teams took measures to improve defensively over the offseason but cincinnati and dallas will still lean heavily on the pass considering their signal callers and pass catching duos burrow projects above prescott as the better qb overall plus his defense didn t undergo nearly as much transformation as the cowboys unit sandwiched in between them is goff always a groomsman never a groom goff has finished second in passing yards for three straight years the extensive sample size includes working under multiple coordinators and playing opposite a wide range of defenses in terms of quality he s incredibly consistent and it doesn t hurt that dan campbell has no interest in taking his foot off opponents throats when leading the herbert selection is all about the mike mcdaniel effect offensive tackles rashawn slater and joe alt returning should also be a massive boon to herbert s protection despite center tyler biadasz s season ending injury mayfield who will be playing for a contract threw for 4 000 yards in each of his first two seasons as a buccaneer he was on pace for 4 077 through eight games last year before injuries both to mayfield and those around him contributed to tampa bay s spiral passing touchdowns rest of top five 2 dak prescott 3 matthew stafford 4 brock purdy 5 justin herbert giving burrow the league lead in passing yards and passing touchdowns comes pretty close to predicting he will win ap nfl most valuable player let s call it manifesting his lack of scrambling ability likely prevents him from being the fantasy mvp but he ll be up there burrow has so much firepower at his disposal and the bengals don t have a goal line back who necessitates they go away from ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins in close prescott is similarly stacked at receiver with ceedee lamb and george pickens in 2025 dak was second in inside the 20 passing attempts 99 and third when inside the 10 48 per pro football reference stafford had a season for the ages last year with 46 td passes he essentially used davante adams as a cheat code for six near the goal line and that could again be a recipe for success last season was his first time pacing the nfl in the category though and passing touchdowns isn t a stat that typically sticks year to year hence his slight slide in this ranking purdy has found some consistency in that regard posting a td percentage of 7 0 or better in three of his four seasons he also might have the best pass catching corps of his career following the additions of mike evans de 39 zhaun stribling and deebo samuel see the previous section for herbert who tied prescott for the fifth most dropbacks per game last year 38 7 and whose full breakout feels like it s now or never as he partners with the oc who helped make tua tagovailoa a pro bowler qb rushing yards rest of top five 2 malik willis 3 lamar jackson 4 josh allen 5 drake maye the commanders likely want to make it a point of emphasis to keep daniels healthy after he missed all but seven games in 2025 but the third year quarterback can still pick up chunk gains at will while focusing on getting down or out of bounds before contact he s an electric talent in his scrambling prime and washington s concerns at offensive line following laremy tunsil s torn triceps could force him to display that trait often willis is already an able and willing runner he amassed 174 rushing yards over three starts with green bay in the past two seasons and using his legs might become an integral part of the game plan for a dolphins squad without a ton of proven pass catching talent jackson led the nfl in this category in 2023 and 2024 before injuries limited him to a career low 349 yards last season he didn t seem to have his legs under him at any point in 2025 and could potentially reel it in a little to avoid similar injury struggles this season even still he s lamar allen is always a threat to leave destruction in his wake on a few punishing scrambles a game he topped all qbs with 112 carries a year ago third on that list with 103 maye also has shown he has the chops to tuck it and run to great success qb rushing touchdowns rest of top five 2 jalen hurts 3 jayden daniels 4 malik willis 5 jaxson dart the top two are obvious allen and hurts have taken turns leading the league in quarterback rushing touchdowns for five years now allen is first in nfl history with 79 while hurts sits third with 63 allen gets the nod in 2026 for likely leading the more explosive offense a group that gets to enjoy consistency under joe brady despite the head coaching change philly s offensive output under new coordinator sean mannion is still a question mark especially after the a j brown trade daniels my qb rushing leader isn t built like allen or hurts to force his way into the end zone but he s a prolific enough runner to crack the top five the same goes for willis across the five games in which he played at least 50 of snaps for the packers willis tallied three rushing scores dart missed out on a mention in qb rushing yards because john harbaugh seems capable at least to some degree of convincing dart to minimize the risks he opens himself up to however dart scored nine times on the ground as a rookie and it s difficult to envision him ever backing down when the goal line is in sight non qb rushing yards rest of top five 2 bijan robinson 3 jahmyr gibbs 4 james cook 5 omarion hampton taylor lost the rushing crown to cook by just 36 yards in 2025 after tailing off from a torrid start to the campaign over the colts first 10 games taylor produced outings of 165 102 123 153 and 244 rushing yards that was when indy was operating at its peak with daniel jones looking fully back from his achilles tear those types of performances are again on the menu robinson has enjoyed back to back 1 400 yard rushing seasons and could be in line for more work after atlanta replaced tyler allgeier 157 touches in 2025 with brian robinson just as jahmyr gibbs will take on an even larger load in detroit s backfield sharing it with isiah pacheco versus david montgomery cook is perennially underrated and could absolutely come close to matching his league career high 1 621 rushing yards from 2025 he remains an ultra efficient integral part of an offense that s never finished outside the top 10 in yards during his bills tenure although he only played 56 4 of offensive snaps last season camp reports have suggested he will be more involved in buffalo s passing attack which could keep him on the field more in general hampton is a dark horse to mount a charge up the rushing leaderboard especially if he receives the de 39 von achane treatment for anyone concerned about mike mcdaniel s hot hand comment the oc is the type to enjoy riling up fantasy managers he isn t likely to take the ball away from a running back he compared to hall of famer terrell davis too often non qb rushing touchdowns rest of top five 2 derrick henry 3 jonathan taylor 4 james cook 5 kenneth walker the same argument for gibbs being in the mix for the rushing yards title applies here the 24 year old has scored 29 tds on the ground since 2024 and that was with the now departed david montgomery taking 51 goal line carries during that timeframe per nfl pro henry led the league in goal line carries last year with 35 he s a seemingly ageless monster truck on what figures to be a top offense he ll see plenty of opportunities in close and is still perfectly capable of breaking some long ones for six taylor logged the second most red zone totes 70 and the most red zone yards 204 in 2025 he s also led the league in rushing scores in two of his six nfl seasons while cook loses out on goal line carries to josh allen he s developed a nose for the end zone with 28 rushing tds since 2024 he plays in a more trustworthy offense than bijan robinson and is more locked in as his team s rb1 than kyren williams two players who could ve shown up in this category fantasy managers everywhere were frustrated last year by the seahawks frequently riding with walker to get down the field only to turn to zach charbonnet at the goal line charbonnet ranked fifth in goal line attempts in 2025 with 27 while walker only saw 12 that shouldn t be a concern now that kwiii is on the chiefs walker should play a pivotal role in kansas city s offense one led by the great patrick mahomes with a 36 year old travis kelce and uncertain depth at wide receiver walker should have plenty of chances to be the guy to score editor s update green bay s josh jacobs originally ranked fourth in this category but was removed after the nfl placed jacobs on the commissioner s exempt list on sunday receptions rest of top five 2 puka nacua 3 amon ra st brown 4 brock bowers 5 jaxon smith njigba chase sat a game in 2025 and still paced the nfl with 185 targets he had to deal with the arduous journey from jake browning to joe flacco amid joe burrow s injury and still trailed nacua the receptions leader with 129 by just four catches the bengals throw a ton and burrow targets chase a ton which after a little rudimentary math equates to a ton of catches for chase assuming both sides of the qb wr tandem stay healthy nacua could just as easily lead the league in receptions but it s tough to repeat michael thomas was the last to do it back in 2018 and 19 that said if nacua continues to be targeted at a rate anywhere close to 36 4 of his routes his league best figure from last year per next gen stats he obviously has a chance st brown always enjoys a sizeable chunk of detroit s passing offense he finished the 2025 campaign second behind smith njigba 33 9 in total team target share at 29 6 hasn t fallen under 25 since 2022 and was the only pass catcher other than chase to see 170 plus targets 172 in 2025 nothing this offseason has changed the lions receiving focus trey mcbride set a single season tight end record with 126 receptions in 2025 this year that could be bowers whenever no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza takes the qb1 reins for the raiders he ll settle in best with easy targets to bowers kirk cousins spending time under center wouldn t be bad for bowers either the 38 year old s arm is best suited to work in the shorter to intermediate areas bowers lives in after winning ap offensive player of the year jsn is a regression candidate as seattle figures things out under first time offensive coordinator brian fleury regardless he ll be the focal point of the seahawks passing attack receiving yards rest of top five 2 ja 39 marr chase 3 amon ra st brown 4 justin jefferson 5 brock bowers even if nacua doesn t end up with the most receptions in the league he always makes the most of his opportunities he currently holds the all time record with an average of 95 3 receiving yards per game he s also outperformed chase twice in yards per reception since entering the league in 2023 and never done worse than st brown in the category his total team target share of 27 8 from 2025 could jump another few points if his counterpart davante adams continues trending toward lower efficiency between the 20s in his age 34 season of course all nacua projections will need to be revisited if the wideout ultimately receives a suspension from the league following some troubling off field behavior chase and st brown have averaged 1 445 receiving yards and 1 393 receiving yards per season respectively over the past three years and they ll be catching passes from the quarterbacks picked above to finish first and second in passing yards jefferson somehow managed a sixth consecutive 1 000 yard receiving season to begin his career while dealing the calamity that was the vikings 2025 quarterback situation the team is hoping it settled things down by adding kyler murray as the new starter murray hasn t been much better than a league average quarterback in the past few years but that level of play could still be enough of an improvement in minnesota to get a superstar like jefferson back to posting superstar numbers he s had four seasons with 1 400 receiving yards or more and was averaging 15 0 yards per reception through his first five years before falling to 12 5 ypr last season bowers managed to reach 1 194 receiving yards in 2023 as a rookie at a position with a notoriously difficult learning curve entering year 3 he is the raiders offense through the air receiving touchdowns rest of top five 2 a j brown 3 ja 39 marr chase 4 puka nacua 5 george pickens if it s not clear by now st brown chase and nacua are solid bets to be the top three wide receivers in the league in some order both in real life and in fantasy competition there s no need to get too contrarian for all the joking last year about the rams using a goal line receiver davante adams while other teams employed the more traditional goal line back st brown actually led the league with 35 red zone targets three more than adams he is jared goff s go to player in passing situations as the field shrinks while chase has tee higgins to contend with and nacua won t always receive end zone looks in favor of adams larry david had a spite store brown landed in the perfect situation for a spite season the last time brown was traded he followed up with 1 496 yards and 11 tds as a first time eagle in 2022 this offseason philly shipped him to new england where the big bodied wide receiver has displayed quick chemistry with budding star drake maye in a more consistent passing offense than the one he left pickens who trailed st brown and adams in a distant third last year with 23 red zone targets is in a high octane offense and has a mega contract to play for on the franchise tag every touchdown will help scrimmage yards rest of top five 2 christian mccaffrey 3 bijan robinson 4 jonathan taylor 5 puka nacua gibbs finished fifth in scrimmage yards last year behind the three players immediately following him on this list and james cook as mentioned before he s in line for the most logical usage boost of any of them due to david montgomery s departure mccaffrey might not appear as explosive as he once was but he still strikes fear in those who oppose him defenses and fantasy managers alike the 49ers will pile as much work as possible on him in 2023 and 25 his two full seasons with san francisco in which he s been healthy mccaffrey led the league in touches and amassed 2 000 plus scrimmage yards robinson paced all players with 2 298 scrimmage yards last season and boasts the game breaking ability to lead the way again but atlanta s struggle to figure out a quarterback between tua tagovailoa and michael penix gives reason for pause while taylor doesn t possess nearly the same pass catching prowess as gibbs cmc and robinson he averages 244 8 receiving yards a year good enough to elevate him into this grouping if he s to lead the league on the ground that leaves nacua my predicted receiving yards leader to represent his fellow pass catchers he has a bit tougher road to gaudy yardage numbers than the league s many multi faceted running backs sacks rest of top five 2 will anderson 3 aidan hutchinson 4 tuli tuipulotu 5 abdul carter the nfl has witnessed a back to back sack king just once this century t j watt led the league in the category in 2020 and 21 the last to do it before that was reggie white in 1987 and 88 far be it from me to suggest the new record holder for sacks in a season can t top the leaderboard again though garrett collected 23 sacks last year and has actually landed in a better situation with the rams he should be able to pin his ears back far more often while playing with leads in los angeles as compared to his time in cleveland and he has a stronger supporting cast to help draw focus anderson is really coming into his own and still has danielle hunter operating opposite him to keep offensive lines honest anderson a first time all pro last year posted a pressure percentage of 20 0 trailing only micah parsons 20 2 among edge rushers with at least 100 pass rushes per next gen stats he got a little unlucky with only a 2 8 sack rate so he s due to cash in more on the havoc he s so good at wreaking hutchinson is another year past the broken fibula and tibia he suffered in 2024 and he already managed to notch 14 5 sacks while pacing the league with 90 pressures the season directly after his injury still only heading into his age 24 season tuipulotu s sack totals have jumped from 4 5 to 8 5 to 13 even another marginal increase would put him in contention for the sack title carter s inclusion will raise some eyebrows but he actually managed a higher pressure rate as a rookie 15 4 than his teammate brian burns 12 9 who finished second in the league with 16 5 sacks carter also ranked first in the nfl with 45 quick pressures under 2 5 seconds he just happened to only get home four times if carter is over his rookie growing pains a breakout is imminent

news_mentions.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels aims to remind people of his talent: 'I can't live off’ 2024 season
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels' follow-up to his 2024 Offensive Rookie of the Year campaign proved arduous and underwhelming. The Washington Commanders quarterback is intent to reset the narrative once again in Year 3.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels follow up to his 2024 offensive rookie of the year campaign proved arduous and underwhelming the washington commanders signal caller is intent to reset the narrative in year 3 perhaps again rising to the forefront of a stellar quarterback draft class a lot of people what they last saw was me getting hurt so what can i say i can t live off of what was done in 24 daniels said in an interview with sports illustrated s albert breer obviously salute to the other guys in my class drake maye did what he did so did caleb williams so did bo nix hopefully down the line we can go down as the greatest qb class i know we have a long way to go but shout out to them honestly so i have a chance when i get out there in week 1 to showcase my talents once again and remind a lot of people daniels played just seven games due to a sprained knee early in the 2025 season and later a dislocated left elbow but it wasn t solely the absences that turned it into a down year daniels also produced worse results he lost five of his starts the same number of defeats the commanders experienced throughout the entirety of his 17 game rookie season and his completion percentage dropped from 69 0 to 60 6 for a number of reasons daniels could easily bounce back to the form he displayed when first breaking onto the nfl scene wide receiver terry mclaurin is back healthy now joined by stefon diggs who is coming off his seventh 1 000 yard receiving season washington drafted an enticing pass catcher in antonio williams in the third round and while daniels no longer has trusty target zach ertz at tight end chigoziem okonkwo offers a little more pop at the position there s also new offensive coordinator david blough s system which daniels and co believe is perfectly suited for the qb s play style the balance of play action passes the bootlegging stuff that we re able to run to marry up with our run game get those guys moving laterally it s going to help out to be able to get some shots in to showcase what i can do with my arm daniels said i m a passer before i m a runner god just blessed me with legs and the ability to do both he blessed me with legs a lot of people in this league don t have there are some guys that can do it but i look back to the year when josh allen won mvp but lamar jackson had that year and he was still lamar but i think he threw for like 4 000 yards lastly daniels intends to lean on the lessons learned from the injuries he endured in 2025 though he won t change who he is a world class scrambler who rushed for 891 yards as a rookie and 39 7 yards per game in his second season daniels will pick his spots and be smarter about avoiding danger it s situational he said early in the season games are lost more than they re won guys are getting in football shape and feeling things out but when it gets to november december when everybody should be playing their peak football you build up all those reps through time and those games come down to the one yard or one possession so every possession every play matters there aren t many predicting an nfc east title for the commanders and detractors of daniels or the team will rightfully point to an offensive line that struggled throughout camp in the wake of left tackle laremy tunsil tearing his triceps the club didn t have a ton of people in its corner before going all the way to the nfc championship game with daniels as a rookie though rather than resting on having proven doubters wrong once before daniels now sets out to do it again starting with the team s season opener against the philadelphia eagles

news_mentions.headline: Former Bills head coach Sean McDermott predicts Buffalo will reach Super Bowl LXI
news_mentions.description: Former Bills head coach Sean McDermott still roots for Buffalo and believes the team can reach the Super Bowl under Joe Brady.
news_mentions.body_text: nfl media analysts made their super bowl lxi predictions on thursday sean mcdermott recently took his shot at forecasting a matchup as well the former buffalo bills head coach who visited the los angeles rams during training camp amid his year off from coaching was asked on the rich eisen show what could prevent l a from winning it all following a transformative offseason while he likes the rams to make it to the big game mcdermott noted there s other teams he also believes in namely his former one it would be bills rams mcdermott said when asked about his super bowl prediction that would be a great super bowl bills rams listen people ask me all the time hey do you still root for your old team and i said why wouldn t i of course i do i mean the impact that you want to have as a head coach on a team and a community that s one thing but man oh man the impact that that team that building and that community had on me and my family we ll remember that for the rest of our lives that s part of sports the wins and the losses are important but the impact you leave or that is left on people and the fan base and them on you that s the real part of sports the bills fired mcdermott in january following their divisional round exit ending a partnership that had produced eight playoff trips and a 98 50 record over nine years but never a super bowl berth buffalo replaced mcdermott by promoting offensive coordinator joe brady to head coach a move the club believed combined consistency with a new voice at the top that could finally help the bills break through though none of their moves were as earth shattering as the rams trading for myles garrett or having aaron donald unretire the bills went on to retool in a way that impressed mcdermott they traded for dj moore giving quarterback josh allen a certified wr1 and added pass rusher bradley chubb and defensive back chauncey gardner johnson to a defense that s ranked in the top 12 in points allowed for five years running with what they ve done the moves that general manager brandon beane has made and the activity they ve had on the roster just over the last x amount of months i think has been very important mcdermott said so i think if you re betting on a super bowl contender they re certainly one of them i don t see why you wouldn t bet on them it s a humble move for mcdermott to continue backing a team that moved on from him after nearly a decade of sustained success and his humility carried over to his assessment of buffalo s new man in charge most coaches come into a job where the organization is sick or unhealthy in some way mcdermott said joe s coming into a job in a unique fashion i think they are well positioned i know joe is going to do a phenomenal job he spent four years in our building and that s an advantage in and of itself i have all confidence in joe brady moving forward for the buffalo bills four nfl media analysts predicted a bills rams super bowl to cap off the 2026 season with two expecting confetti to fall for los angeles and two calling a buffalo victory mcdermott did not provide a winner to break the tie but it s not hard to guess who he d be pulling for

news_mentions.headline: NFL's Top 100 Players of 2026: Five things voters got wrong
news_mentions.description: Now that "The Top 100 Players of 2026" has concluded, Jeremy Bergman critiques the full list, identifying five things he believes the voters got wrong this year.
news_mentions.body_text: the two month long top 100 players of 2026 rollout has finally come to an end and a new no 1 has been crowned two time defensive player of the year myles garrett is the top player in the nfl per peers a historic choice in the context of the 16 year old ranking garrett is just the second pass rusher to take home the honors following j j watt in 2015 like garrett watt was coming off a dpoy campaign the texans star followed up that season by leading the league in sacks and winning dpoy again in 15 that s a good omen for garrett who also became the first no 1 player to change teams in the offseason now a member of the los angeles rams he will play alongside the unretired aaron donald himself a former no 1 player 2019 the 2025 rams will be the first team since the top 100 began in 2011 to field two players who were voted as the no 1 player at one point in their careers and they re on the same defensive line though the annual nfl countdown ended in an obvious place there were some missteps along the way here are the five things that voters got wrong in this year s edition of the top 100 1 super bowl champs snubbed a year ago i complained in this very here column that the defending champion eagles were overrepresented in the top 100 when 10 birds cracked the ranking a full 10 percent of the list the players clearly heard me and swung the pendulum in the other direction almost shutting out the reigning champs from seattle offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba sam darnold and ernest jones are the lone representatives from mike macdonald s squad which to be fair flew under the radar for most of the regular season teams win titles not individual players and the 2025 seahawks were arguably greater than the sum of their parts but some of their parts are pretty special how about devon witherspoon who could have won super bowl mvp honors and just went straight to the bank with a record setting cb extension or leonard williams the big cat who finally made an all pro squad in his 11th nfl season and on his third franchise nick emmanwori the defensive rookie of the year runner up could have followed droy winner carson schwesinger onto the ranking that the hawks nfc west rivals in los angeles and san francisco each have more representatives in this year s ranking is i guess no surprise the rams nfl high seven players including three in the top 10 are packed with notable names and just traded for the no 1 player in the league san francisco five is a perennial contender with household personalities by comparison seattle home to grunge rock were new on the scene fittingly rising from the underground in 25 after finishing on top of the world the league can t ignore them this time around 2 qb questions the most wtf moment of the months long top 100 rollout came nearly halfway through when two time mvp lamar jackson was revealed to have been voted as the no 69 player in the league by his peers jackson s 67 spot drop after two straight years at no 2 flummoxed casual onlookers as did the subsequent reveals of trevor lawrence no 62 bo nix no 59 and jalen hurts no 56 ahead of him sure lawrence was an mvp finalist nix piloted the afc s top team and hurts threw a career high 25 touchdowns but why the disrespect to jackson the townspeople cry out in the dark of the qb questions that arise from this year s players poll this one to me is the least vexing lamar had his most un lamar like season aside from the injuries which seem to rankle every one of his campaigns hampered by ailments he logged a career low 349 rushing yards led baltimore to more losses seven than wins six was 21st of 33 qualifying qbs in expected points added per dropback per next gen stats and came up a tyler loop miss short of the postseason jackson s air game was more explosive than ever league high 13 3 yards per catch but otherwise the ravens star did not live up to his own standard whereas the playoff bound campaigns led by lawrence and nix were welcome surprises and hurts was the steady captain of a turbulent eagles campaign verdict the players may have actually gotten that one right the more surprising call by the players was at the tippy top sticking with josh allen at no 2 over eventual league mvp matthew stafford at no 4 i say eventual because the polling for this exercise is typically done before the season ends allen may be the more dynamic he s younger by a good eight years and always been more mobile but stafford was the league s most prolific passer last year by the most important metrics 4 707 yards 46 tds 276 9 ypg and led the nfl s top total and scoring offense allen meanwhile didn t hit the standard he set in his 2024 mvp campaign no 3 overall in the top 100 though he improved his completion percentage in 2025 allen took a career worst 40 sacks and committed 17 turnovers that s not even including his two picks and three fumbles in buffalo s heartbreaking divisional round loss to denver allen may not have been the best quarterback in his division last season the margins were surely slim at the top but stafford despite enjoying a career best ranking should feel snubbed 3 cmc the no 2 rb how nit picky do i want to be christian mccaffrey no 5 and jahmyr gibbs no 9 both enjoyed standout seasons in 2025 earning rightful places in the top 10 behind top rb bijan robinson no 3 all three are dual threat dynamos who deserve to be among the highest paid at their position sonic and bijan leapfrogged cmc this offseason behind those top three running backs fell derrick henry no 15 jonathan taylor no 17 rushing leader james cook no 20 and de 39 von achane no 26 based on last year s production that s an impressive and pretty unassailable top seven sorry ex no 1 saquon barkley and kyren williams a surprising afterthought at no 89 but i will quibble with the final order robinson s 2025 campaign is undeniable and deserving of the top spot a league high 2 298 yards from scrimmage 6 3 yards per touch but behind him i have some questions cmc s comeback season was fruitful for san francisco he was ever the workhorse in his return from injury leading the league with 413 touches en route to first team all pro honors alongside robinson but mccaffrey s efficiency wasn t there of 70 qualified rushers cmc was 69th in rushing yards over expected per game 9 7 just above tampa bay s bucky irving mccaffrey was last among the aforementioned magnificent seven in rushing yards per game 70 7 and expected points added per game 1 6 his drop in efficiency was driven by his 3 3 yards per carry average on attempts directed outside the tackles the second fewest among qualified rbs per next gen stats meanwhile cook henry and achane each averaged at least 1 rushing yard over expected per attempt achane led the nfl with 5 7 yards per carry and taylor and gibbs paced all nflers with 20 and 18 touchdowns respectively as a receiver cmc gets credit for logging an historic third 100 100 season and pacing all rbs in receiving epa 32 with robinson and gibbs behind him but his deficiencies in the running game cannot be overlooked cmc should have landed in the top 20 but the top six is a little rich for my blood inspiring comeback story notwithstanding 4 sol for offensive defensive interior for the nth year in a row the rank and file have disrespected the hog mollies on both the offensive and defensive side of the ball just three interior linemen cracked the top 100 and just one made it into the top 90 quenton nelson at no 99 creed humphrey at no 94 joe thuney at no 49 when it comes to d tackles only four made the list derrick brown jeffery simmons chris jones and jalen carter dexter lawrence who had a down year in east rutherford just missed the cut at no 105 a number of highly paid all pros were also sidelined including quinn meinerz chris lindstrom and aaron brewer where too are the likes of leonard williams who just broke the bank again and cameron heyward if this summer s spending habits are any indication the league s front offices and players are at odds over the value on the game s grunt workers gms increasingly see interior people movers as integral pieces worth nearly as much as the stars on the outside how else do you explain peter skoronski s 100m deal the ball carriers and pass rushers put up the sexy stats but often their lanes are paved by the men in the middle maybe next year the players will take notice but i m not holding my breath 5 where are the rookies usually i reserve this final space to complain that not enough teams were represented in the ranking but this year all but one nfl club saw at least one of its players from 2025 represented the jets could have claimed quinnen williams if he had made the final cut but the cowboys star was snubbed along with most of his fellow dts my closing gripe this year is where are all the first years tetairoa mcmillan and carson schwesinger the reigning offensive and defensive rookie of the year are the only members of the 2025 draft class mentioned in this ranking fair enough but what about their ungilded draftmates no 3 overall pick abdul carter ranked seventh among qualified pass rushers in 2025 with 72 qb pressures tyler warren just missed the cut at no 110 but was fifth among tight ends with 817 receiving yards only four tes made this year s ranking nick emmanwori was a key piece of seattle s super bowl champion dark side secondary shedeur sanders was a pro bowler i kid

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Former Bills head coach Sean McDermott predicts Buffalo will reach Super Bowl LXI
material_news_signals.description: Former Bills head coach Sean McDermott still roots for Buffalo and believes the team can reach the Super Bowl under Joe Brady.
material_news_signals.body_text: nfl media analysts made their super bowl lxi predictions on thursday sean mcdermott recently took his shot at forecasting a matchup as well the former buffalo bills head coach who visited the los angeles rams during training camp amid his year off from coaching was asked on the rich eisen show what could prevent l a from winning it all following a transformative offseason while he likes the rams to make it to the big game mcdermott noted there s other teams he also believes in namely his former one it would be bills rams mcdermott said when asked about his super bowl prediction that would be a great super bowl bills rams listen people ask me all the time hey do you still root for your old team and i said why wouldn t i of course i do i mean the impact that you want to have as a head coach on a team and a community that s one thing but man oh man the impact that that team that building and that community had on me and my family we ll remember that for the rest of our lives that s part of sports the wins and the losses are important but the impact you leave or that is left on people and the fan base and them on you that s the real part of sports the bills fired mcdermott in january following their divisional round exit ending a partnership that had produced eight playoff trips and a 98 50 record over nine years but never a super bowl berth buffalo replaced mcdermott by promoting offensive coordinator joe brady to head coach a move the club believed combined consistency with a new voice at the top that could finally help the bills break through though none of their moves were as earth shattering as the rams trading for myles garrett or having aaron donald unretire the bills went on to retool in a way that impressed mcdermott they traded for dj moore giving quarterback josh allen a certified wr1 and added pass rusher bradley chubb and defensive back chauncey gardner johnson to a defense that s ranked in the top 12 in points allowed for five years running with what they ve done the moves that general manager brandon beane has made and the activity they ve had on the roster just over the last x amount of months i think has been very important mcdermott said so i think if you re betting on a super bowl contender they re certainly one of them i don t see why you wouldn t bet on them it s a humble move for mcdermott to continue backing a team that moved on from him after nearly a decade of sustained success and his humility carried over to his assessment of buffalo s new man in charge most coaches come into a job where the organization is sick or unhealthy in some way mcdermott said joe s coming into a job in a unique fashion i think they are well positioned i know joe is going to do a phenomenal job he spent four years in our building and that s an advantage in and of itself i have all confidence in joe brady moving forward for the buffalo bills four nfl media analysts predicted a bills rams super bowl to cap off the 2026 season with two expecting confetti to fall for los angeles and two calling a buffalo victory mcdermott did not provide a winner to break the tie but it s not hard to guess who he d be pulling for
